## Problem

What archive inspection or extraction problem cannot be represented clearly
today?

## Proposed API or behavior

Show the proposed option, method or output shape. Keep it zero-dependency and
framework-agnostic.

## Security impact

Explain how the proposal preserves fail-closed behavior. State any new false
positives, false negatives, resource limits or parser differentials.

## Alternatives considered

List existing options or caller-side code that can solve the problem.
